Portronics SoundDrum 1 Portable Speaker – Powerful Bass, 12W Output & Bluetooth 5.3

Experience immersive sound performance with the Portronics SoundDrum 1 Portable Speaker, designed for music lovers who want powerful bass, crystal-clear audio, and true portability. This compact yet powerful speaker delivers an impressive 12W RMS output packed inside a sleek, lightweight body. Whether you are relaxing at home, traveling, or hosting a small gathering, this speaker ensures rich sound quality with deep bass and minimal distortion.

The Portronics SoundDrum 1 Portable Speaker, 5-6 Hour Playback, In Built Mic, Powerful Bass is powered by an advanced Bluetooth 5.3 chipset that ensures faster pairing, stable connectivity, and low latency. Enjoy seamless wireless streaming from smartphones, tablets, laptops, and other Bluetooth-enabled devices without interruptions.

Powerful Sound with Deep Bass Performance

Equipped with a high-performance driver and passive bass radiator, the delivers enhanced bass response that elevates your listening experience. The 12W RMS output ensures loud, distortion-free sound, making it ideal for indoor and outdoor use. From music and movies to podcasts and calls, every sound feels fuller and more dynamic.

Long-Lasting Battery & Multiple Playback Options

With a 2000mAh lithium-ion battery, the speaker provides up to 5–6 hours of continuous playback on a single charge. Enjoy uninterrupted entertainment without worrying about frequent recharging. The supports multiple input modes including Bluetooth, USB, offering flexible listening options based on your preference.

Built-In Microphone for Hands-Free Calling

Stay connected with the built-in microphone that allows hands-free calling directly through the speaker. The in built mic ensures clear voice transmission, making the perfect for conference calls, online meetings, and voice assistants.

Compact Design & Lightweight Portability

Designed for portability, the speaker weighs just 422 g and features a compact product size of 7.9 x 7.9 x 9.5 cm. The premium black color finish gives it a modern, stylish look that complements any environment. Easily carry it in your bag and enjoy powerful sound wherever you go.

Key Features & Specifications

  • Audio Output: 12W RMS powerful sound
  • Playback Time: 5–6 hours
  • Connectivity: Bluetooth 5.3 for stable wireless streaming
  • Input Options: Bluetooth, USB
  • Battery Capacity: 2000mAh Lithium-ion
  • Built-in Microphone: Yes
  • Weight: 422 g
  • Product Dimensions: 7.9 x 7.9 x 9.5 cm
  • Color: Black

Why Choose Portronics SoundDrum 1?

The is an excellent choice for users looking for a compact Bluetooth speaker with powerful bass, reliable battery life, and versatile connectivity. Its premium build quality, enhanced sound output, and portable design make it one of the best portable speakers in its category.

Whether you are searching for a Bluetooth speaker for home, a portable speaker for travel, or a wireless speaker with mic, the SoundDrum 1 delivers exceptional value and performance. Upgrade your audio experience with and enjoy music the way it’s meant to be heard.
